title: Gateway model listing must be filtered per endpoint by USE permission, not just authenticated
answers: users see gateway endpoints they cannot use in the OpenAI models list
client.models.list() shows endpoints from other workspaces or without USE permission
how is access to /gateway/mlflow/v1/models restricted when auth is on
why does the gateway models endpoint return endpoints a user has no USE grant for
body:
Symptom: with MLflow auth enabled, a user who lacks USE permission on a gateway endpoint still sees its name in GET /gateway/mlflow/v1/models (or client.models.list()).
Root cause: mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models returns every named endpoint from store.list_gateway_endpoints(); it has no authorization of its own.
Fix pattern: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_get_gateway_validator returns the authentication-only validator for this path, and mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_filter_list_gateway_models drops each item whose id fails _validate_gateway_use_permission. The filter is registered in FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS keyed by the imported list_models function.
Constraints: the per-endpoint check keeps administrator access and workspace isolation, as tested by test_list_models_filters_by_use_permission and test_list_models_isolates_workspaces in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py. The PR accepts O(n) checks because discovery is infrequent. Any new gateway route that lists resources needs the same post-filter, or it leaks.
Applies: auth-enabled servers (basic-auth) serving gateway listing routes.
applies: Any new or edited gateway route that returns a list of endpoints or models under auth.
says: Users can see AI gateway endpoints in the model list without permission to use them.
The available models list displays endpoints belonging to other isolated workspaces.
Filter out unauthorized gateway models so users only see endpoints they have access to.
Restricted gateway endpoints are still visible when browsing available models under basic authentication.
search: Gateway model listings under basic-auth must filter endpoints by USE permission to enforce workspace isolation and access control. Because mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models lacks authorization, mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py registers _filter_list_gateway_models in FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS to drop endpoints failing _validate_gateway_use_permission. Authentication is handled by _get_gateway_validator, and any new gateway route listing resources requires the same post-filter to avoid leaks.
